description: This file defines TypeScript types and function signatures related to bundled plugin build entries, including types for plugin entries and parameters, as well as functions for collecting and listing build entries, artifacts, and dependencies.

methods.name: export function collectBundledPluginBuildEntries( collectBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Collects and returns an array of bundled plugin build entries based on provided parameters.

methods.name: listBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Returns a record mapping plugin identifiers to strings, representing bundled plugin build entries.

methods.name: listBundledPluginPackArtifacts
methods.description: Returns a list of strings representing packaged artifacts for bundled plugins.

methods.name: listBundledPluginRuntimeDependencies
methods.description: Returns a list of strings indicating runtime dependencies of the bundled plugins.
